proposal.rationale: The 10 undetermined sections are mostly repealed shells (Acts 151/1899, 56/1905, 59/1937, 314/1941, 382/1927) or narrow profession/agency-specific acts (Act 99/1972 investigatory authority, Act 297/1965 sale of medical/dental practice, Act 255/1968 medical personnel, Act 381/1974 former offenders). None contain anchor text with a universal "applies to every person/profession" signal or an enumerated list of practice-act citations that the trigger patterns would catch. Act 381/1974 (former offenders) is arguably cross-cutting ("when used as a requirement for an occupational or professional license"), but it is scoped to its own act's good-moral-character determinations rather than declaring universal applicability to all practice acts — better to leave undetermined for manual triage than risk false positives. Keeping patterns as-is.
